behavior: AC1: a goos/goarch asset key wins over goos, and goos still resolves alone
verification: cd cli && go test ./internal/tools/ -run '^TestAssetName_PrefersGoosGoarchOverGoos$' -count=1 -v | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestAssetName_PrefersGoosGoarchOverGoos'

behavior: AC2: ./name and *name checksum manifest lines verify name
verification: cd cli && go test ./internal/tools/ -run '^TestExpectedChecksum_AcceptsSha256sumNameForms$' -count=1 -v | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestExpectedChecksum_AcceptsSha256sumNameForms'

behavior: AC3: install skips a github-release tool with no asset for this OS/arch, without an error
verification: cd cli && go test ./internal/tools/ -run '^TestInstall_NoAssetForThisPlatformIsSkippedNotFailed$' -count=1 -v | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestInstall_NoAssetForThisPlatformIsSkippedNotFailed'

behavior: AC4: the catalog installs the pinned mise, checksum-verified and exec-probed
AC5: dotf tools sync renders conf.d/dotfiles.toml, installs, probes, and is idempotent
verification: cd cli && go test ./internal/tools/ -run '^TestSync_RendersInstallsProbesAndIsIdempotent$' -count=1 -v | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestSync_RendersInstallsProbesAndIsIdempotent'

behavior: AC6: converge runs the tools step after the records step (registry order), and the step plans, applies, then has nothing to do
verification: cd cli && out=$(go test ./internal/converge/ -run '^(TestToolsSync_PlanThenApplyThenNothingToDo|TestRegistry_ToolsRunAfterRecords)$' -count=1 -v) && printf '%s' "$out" | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestToolsSync_PlanThenApplyThenNothingToDo' && printf '%s' "$out" | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestRegistry_ToolsRunAfterRecords'

behavior: AC7: a system entry installs through the OS manager, skips on an OS it does not name, and a second run runs no manager command
verification: cd cli && out=$(go test ./internal/tools/ -run '^(TestInstallSystem_ArgvPerManager|TestInstallSystem_SecondRunRunsNothing|TestInstallSystem_NoNameForThisOSIsSkipped)$' -count=1 -v) && printf '%s' "$out" | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestInstallSystem_ArgvPerManager' && printf '%s' "$out" | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestInstallSystem_SecondRunRunsNothing' && printf '%s' "$out" | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestInstallSystem_NoNameForThisOSIsSkipped'

behavior: AC8: Load rejects a malformed system entry naming it, and Install skips an unknown source type
verification: cd cli && out=$(go test ./internal/tools/ -run '^(TestLoad_RejectsMalformedSystemEntries|TestInstall_UnknownSourceTypeIsSkippedNotFailed)$' -count=1 -v) && printf '%s' "$out" | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestLoad_RejectsMalformedSystemEntries' && printf '%s' "$out" | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestInstall_UnknownSourceTypeIsSkippedNotFailed'
